desc: Build vLLM from source with the upstream procedure (CUDA, CPU, ROCm, XPU; Linux and macOS) and run one generation.
note: Builds into a venv of a vLLM-compatible Python: the release tag (--checkout=v0.30.0), torch matching the local CUDA toolkit, VLLM_TARGET_DEVICE from --compute, TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST of the detected GPU, MAX_JOBS that fits the RAM.
